notes.title: Version 1.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce a few improvements to Conquest!
This update has now been released.

Patch notes:

- Optimized battles quite significantly.

※ All previous save files will be compatible.
※ Update may not be available in all regions immediately.

I hope the following video shows just how better things run now.
Thank you all for your patience and your support!

[previewyoutube=q2o3WPmrdwI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Sneak Peek: Upcoming Optimization Update
notes.notes:
Hello Conquerors,

I have received quite a lot of feedback. With my last update, I fixed up a few things people were having trouble with on the world map and campaign creation. 

With the next update, I am going to tackle the biggest issue for a lot of users: 
- Fixing lag in Battles

This should have been supported from Day 1. 
I do apologize that the game doesn't run so well on some machines. 
As a solo-dev, I only have a few personal machines to test on and I didn't recognize there were such problems. Now that I know, it is my top priority!

I hope that I can get this update out quickly. 
Wish me luck!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39694600/28601ed497f9534a401064d3e2ca3b74552f5cbd.png

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce a few improvements to Conquest!
This update has now been released.

Patch notes:

- Ability to customize the name of your faction.
- Ability to customize the name of your faction's first king.
- Ability to customize your faction's flag.
- Improved Civil War mechanism.
- Ability to improve your king's popularity and religiosity (to prevent civil wars).
- Penalties to religiosity for declaring war on nations of the same faith.
- Penalties to popularity for losing wars.
- Slightly expanded tutorial content.

※ All previous save files will be compatible.
※ Update may not be available in all regions immediately.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39694600/f948379491cb579a42570f633756eb404a6fe95e.png

notes.title: Sneak Peek: Upcoming Update
notes.notes:
Hello Conquerors,

Thank you all for the many kind words and support since release.
This is the first game I have ever released on Steam, so it's been a great experience.

I have received some feedback and would like to keep you guys informed on what I plan for the next update:

1) Faction renaming.
2) King renaming.
3) Improved "Popularity" and "Religiosity" management.
4) Better rebellion system.

Basically, up until now, rebellions have been a curse for unpopular kings; which is a dice-roll when your current king dies. I'm going to make it possible to increase your king's popularity to prevent rebellions occurring.

5) Flag creator.  (*possibly... if it's not ready by the next update, I'll add it in the update after that)

Looking forward to putting the update out. 
Thank you all once again!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39694600/c2d0bcf6a6d09954e1a19a815fb0efea5ad6bcec.png
I love how the name generator chose "Myland" as a country name.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Update
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce a few fixes in this first update to Conquest!
This update has now been released.

Patch notes:

- Fixed a bug where some tutorial text was getting cut off at the bottom.
- Fixed a bug where destroyed nations were still being courted diplomatically by surviving nations.
- Fixed a bug where you could waste a turn spending zero resources to replenish an already completely replenished army.
- Fixed a bug where custom battles would rewrite the Autosave file with nonsense.
- Changed it so that Autosaves occur at the start of every turn (previously there was only one Autosave at the start of a new game).
- Added some explanatory text to the "Replenish" feature.
- Added a "Version: xxx" label to the main menu.

※ All previous save files will be compatible.
※ Update may not be available in all regions immediately.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39694600/4a5c256afe8ef5ee2e18a124d230ca8360e50d60.png

notes.title: Dev Update: Polishing, Final Touches, Tutorial
notes.notes:
Hello there!

As usual, it's been a while since my last announcement, so I thought I should make a post to explain where the project is at.
I'm on the last stretch of development -- bug fixing, testing and balancing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39694600/f042d931b69cdd58a87f29195de2818f3275840c.png

The biggest thing left to get done is some work on the Battle Camera, and a quick tutorial page just to explain some of the concepts that might be intuitive at first glance (all kings need some counsel).

I thank you all for your patience. This is a project I have been working on in my spare time. I am a one-man team with a full-time job doing other unrelated work, so progress is slow. However, the game should be coming out in May. That is the goal I have set myself. Hopefully, it all goes to plan.

notes.title: Dev Update: Bug Fixes, Testing and Balancing
notes.notes:
Hello there!

It's been a while since my last announcement, so I thought I'd shout out so everyone can see things are still moving forward.
In fact, I'm on the last stretch of the project -- bug fixing, testing and balancing.

Basically, I'm now playing the game -- doing as much weird stuff that I can to break it -- and then fixing any problems I find. I'm also balancing anything that seems off or exploitable. 
Of course, I'm a one-man team and this is a side-project for me, so things aren't moving at breakneck speed, but they are plodding along.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39694600/523e304e512cfd302cd70e4c342bb89b9845b7f7.png
(Here's a behind the scenes look at development. As you may see, I also balanced the "Continents" map type so it produced more natural worlds. I'm happy with the result.)

It's great to see that people are adding Conquest to their wishlists. 
That really makes me happy. This is my first PC game, and I hope it meets expectations -- even for a first-time indie-guy!

notes.title: Dev Update: Working on Balancing
notes.notes:
Hello world! I've got a lot of the game done and I've been working on balancing quite a bit recently. 
I've made a "Custom Battle" mode, where you can easily set up a fight with as many as 20000 soldiers.

I have to be honest. The game absolutely slows down on my old MacBook that I'm developing this on, but it should be good for those of you with gaming super-computers.
As for those of us with computers like myself, there is a setting to drop the number of soldiers per unit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39694600/f0a2c5910c7124dea7d5b1e2dfbe002d9ab2ed1d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39694600/821e5c4b4fb93c2d009eb8869d6bcba34c7a2992.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39694600/49d9a1791fd967ac47c153cc452818c3f4600907.png

I have a few things I still need to get working properly and a bit of balancing to make the game feel good.
But I am happy to say that progress is being made!

notes.title: Dev Update: Working on UI and AI
notes.notes:
Working on some of the UI and AI recently. Things may change before release but at the moment, things are starting to come together.

There is more and more content being added to the game as I work on it. This week I hope to get the UI pretty much done, and implement Seiges. At present, enemy castles can be conquered just like any other region, however I want to make it so that it requires time to conquer a castle. This will give the AI (or yourself, if you are the one being beseiged) time to rally an army to defend the castle. 

It also makes blitzkrieging the enemy a bit more complex, since there will be no way to simply steamroll an enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39694600/c3d7c4e65e18f11db4b6d2c491c60fd164f574a4.png

notes.title: Dev Update: Progress Report (And New Map Types)
notes.notes:
Just a quick update to let everyone know I've been working on the game quite a bit recently. 
A lot of it has been about getting the economy to work right and feel a bit balanced. 
I also added an Economy tab so you can see exactly where all your resources are coming from, and where they're going.

Things are going well and the game is progressing. I'm quite happy considering this is an entire one-man part-time job. 

I added some map types just to make things a bit interesting. There are "Earth-Like" maps, and a map of Britain and Ireland. I also added a Desert Planet map type just for the fun of it.... might be a bit hard to scrap together food or wood on that map, but that's just what you'll have to deal with if you choose this map type.

Hopefully, I'll have the game out soon as possible. Thanks for the support! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39694600/3fd9b5db88f299e9d61259bd77d7751342074f74.png

notes.title: Dev Update: Diplomacy
notes.notes:
Just a quick update to let you know I've been working on diplomacy recently. 
You can trade resources, declare war, demand vassalage, and of course, find out what they think of you, and other nations.

Each nation has a unique king with characteristics that will affect how they interact with the world.

The screenshot below is from a game with over a hundred nations, each with their own attitude and position in the world.
